name: 护国寺小吃
experience_value: Useful when the day should begin with recognizable local food rhythm rather than neutral coffee-shop utility.
Supports student and solo routes that need budget-efficient flavor memory early in the day.
Creates a route backbone through eating culture rather than through another major sightseeing headline.
avoid_when: the route already includes a stronger breakfast or snack cluster and would become repetitive
the itinerary needs a polished romantic start rather than a practical local-food opening
the traveler has very limited appetite for snack-style or queue-prone food stops
